entries.title: Psalms 52:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. Maschil of David; when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Abimelech.>> Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? The lovingkindness of God [endureth] continually.

entries.title: Psalms 52:2
segments: Thy tongue deviseth very wickedness, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

entries.title: Psalms 52:3
segments: Thou lovest evil more than good, And lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 52:4
segments: Thou lovest all devouring words, thou deceitful tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 52:5
segments: God will likewise destroy thee for ever; He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 52:6
segments: The righteous also shall see [it], and fear, And shall laugh at him, [saying],

entries.title: Psalms 52:7
segments: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.

entries.title: Psalms 52:8
segments: But as for me, I am like a green olive-tree in the house of God: I trust in the lovingkindness of God for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 52:9
segments: I will give thee thanks for ever, because thou hast done it; And I will hope in thy name, for it is good, in the presence of thy saints.
